note: Survey 주제별 전용 문항입니다. 키는 survey.json의 option id입니다. 문항을 추가하려면 같은 형식으로 항목을 늘리면 됩니다. 모든 문항은 독자적으로 작성한 연습용 문항입니다.

movies.text: You indicated that you like watching movies. What kinds of movies do you like, and who are your favorite actors? Tell me why you like them.
Describe what you usually do when you go to the movies. Who do you go with, how do you choose a movie, and what do you do before and after it?
Tell me about a movie that left a strong impression on you. What was the story about, and why was it so memorable?
Compare the movie theaters you went to as a child with the theaters today. What are the biggest differences?
More and more people watch new movies at home on streaming services instead of going to theaters. What do you think about this trend?

concert.text: You said that you enjoy going to concerts. What kind of music concerts do you usually go to, and where are they usually held?
What do you usually do before and after going to a concert? Tell me about how you buy tickets and how you get there.
Tell me about the most exciting concert you have ever been to. Who performed, who were you with, and what made it special?
How have concerts changed compared to the past? Think about ticket prices, the size of the venues, and how people enjoy the show.

park.text: You indicated that you like going to parks. Describe a park you often go to. Where is it, and what does it look like?
What do you usually do when you go to the park? Who do you go with, and how long do you usually stay?
Tell me about a memorable day you spent at a park. What happened, and why do you remember it?
Compare the parks you went to as a child with the parks today. What has changed?

beach.text: You said you like going to the beach. Tell me about your favorite beach. Where is it, and what makes it special?
What do you usually do when you go to the beach? Describe your typical day there from morning to evening.
Tell me about a memorable trip you took to the beach. What happened during that trip?

cafe.text: You indicated that you go to cafes. Describe a cafe you often visit. What does it look like, and why do you like going there?
What do you usually do at cafes? Do you meet friends, study, or work? Tell me about your usual routine.
Tell me about a memorable experience you had at a cafe. Maybe you met someone special or something unexpected happened.
Cafes in Korea have changed a lot over the years. Compare the cafes of the past with the cafes today.

shopping.text: You said that you like shopping. Where do you usually go shopping, and what do you like to buy?
Describe how you usually shop. Do you make a list, compare prices, or shop online? Tell me about your shopping habits.
Tell me about a time when you bought something and had a problem with it. What happened, and how did you solve it?
Compare shopping online with shopping in a store. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?

tv.text: You indicated that you watch TV. What kinds of TV programs do you like, and why do you enjoy them?
When and where do you usually watch TV? Describe your routine for watching your favorite shows.
Tell me about a TV show that you really enjoyed. What was it about, and why did you like it so much?
How has the way people watch TV changed compared to when you were young?

music.text: You said that you enjoy listening to music. What kind of music do you like, and who are your favorite singers or musicians?
When and where do you usually listen to music? What devices or apps do you use?
How did you first become interested in music? Tell me how your taste in music has changed since you were young.
Tell me about a memorable experience you had while listening to live music.
Compare the way people listened to music in the past with how people listen to music today.

cooking.text: You indicated that you like cooking. What kinds of food do you like to cook, and what is your best dish?
Tell me how you usually prepare a meal. What do you do from buying ingredients to cleaning up?
Tell me about a time when your cooking did not go as planned. What happened, and what did you do?
Compare cooking at home with eating out. Which do you prefer, and why?

reading.text: You said that you like reading. What kinds of books do you enjoy, and who is your favorite author?
When and where do you usually read? Describe your reading habits.
Tell me about a book that made a strong impression on you. What was it about, and how did it affect you?
Compare reading paper books with reading e-books. Which do you prefer, and why?

walking.text: You indicated that you enjoy walking. Where do you usually go for a walk, and what is the place like?
Tell me about your walking routine. When do you walk, how long do you walk, and who do you walk with?
Tell me about a memorable experience you had while you were out on a walk.

jogging.text: You said you go jogging. Where do you usually jog, and what is that place like?
Describe your jogging routine. What do you do before you start, while you jog, and after you finish?
Tell me about a time something unexpected happened while you were jogging.

gym.text: You indicated that you work out at a gym. Describe the gym you go to. What does it look like, and what equipment does it have?
Tell me about your workout routine at the gym. What exercises do you do, and in what order?
Tell me about a memorable experience you had at the gym.

domesticTravel.text: You indicated that you enjoy traveling in Korea. Tell me about a place in Korea that you like to visit. What is it like?
How do you usually prepare for a domestic trip? Tell me how you plan, where you stay, and how you get there.
Tell me about the most memorable trip you have taken in Korea. Where did you go, and what happened?
Compare traveling in Korea with traveling abroad. What are the good and bad points of each?

overseasTravel.text: You said that you like traveling abroad. Tell me about a country you have visited. What was it like there?
What do you usually do to get ready for an overseas trip? Tell me about everything you do before you leave.
Tell me about something unexpected or memorable that happened during an overseas trip.
Compare the first overseas trip you took with your most recent one. How were they different?

homeVacation.text: You indicated that you spend your vacations at home. What do you like to do when you are on vacation at home, and why?
Tell me about the people you like to see or spend time with when you are on vacation at home.
Tell me about a vacation you spent at home that was especially memorable. What did you do?
